inputs.original_text: Daniel Rubenstein is right: peace that overlooks Iran’s nuclear and missile programs is no peace at all—just danger deferred. Israel’s leaders have a duty to put their people’s security first. Strength and national resolve are not barriers to a settlement; they are what make one credible.
inputs.modified_text: Daniel Rubenstein is right: calling it peace while Iran’s nuclear and missile programs remain unaddressed is wishful thinking, not security. Israel’s leaders have a duty to protect their people and preserve the nation’s security. A settlement only means something when backed by strength and resolve; otherwise, it risks putting political appearances ahead of the safety of families.
